subject.title: WORKING: All Microsoft Issues and PRs (refresh)

question: Should OpenClaw own this Microsoft-specific tracker and PR-body updater on `main`, or keep it as draft administrative tracking backed by existing GitHub and ClawSweeper views?
rationale: Mechanical repairs cannot decide whether a large, continuously refreshed Microsoft-specific administrative artifact should become a permanent repository workflow and second source of triage state.

options.title: Keep As Draft Tracking
options.body: Continue using the PR body or external live reports for Microsoft cleanup without merging the generated tracker and updater into `main`.

options.title: Adopt After Redesign
options.body: Sponsor the repository-owned workflow only after all generator findings are fixed and redacted live proof demonstrates safe generation and PR-body updates.

options.title: Close The Workflow
options.body: Close the draft if maintainers do not want a Microsoft-specific tracking surface maintained in this repository.

recommendation.title: Keep As Draft Tracking
recommendation.body: Continue using the PR body or external live reports for Microsoft cleanup without merging the generated tracker and updater into `main`.

likelyOwner.reason: The available current-main history connects this person to both repository script policy and the release-owned file changed by the PR.
